messages:
maria_sales: Hey @noah_sece — NorthBridge Health sent over a SIG/CAIQ-style questionnaire. They want specific IAM/access-control evidence for our hosted offering: SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof for admin users and service accounts, RBAC role definitions + screenshots, and an audit sample for provisioning. POC demo is Tues 10am. Can we pull a pack by EOD Mon?
noah_sece: Quick q — this is for our hosted SaaS org (shared control plane), right? If so we can provide config screenshots, SAML metadata, policy docs, and an attestation. We can't hand over customer logs with PII, but we can supply redacted samples and explain retention.
noah_sece: Also: do they want SCIM provisioning logs or just SCIM config + sample events?
maria_sales: Hosted SaaS. They explicitly listed: SAML metadata, SSO config steps, MFA enforcement proof (policy + screenshot showing enforcement on admin role), RBAC roles export (CSV ok), a mapping from SIG sections to our controls, and example SCIM events. They called out least-privilege rationale.
jin_eng: I can generate an RBAC export CSV and a sanitized SCIM event sample from staging. I need a support ticket (org_id) and a redaction checklist before pulling any logs.
jin_eng: Example export CLI for reference:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/{org_id}/rbac/export" \ 
  -o rbac-export.csv
```
alex_solutions: Recommend we assemble a single "Authz Evidence Bundle":
- SAML metadata file (.xml) + short SSO setup screenshot
- MFA policy doc + admin-role enforcement screenshot
- RBAC roles CSV + one screenshot of role editor
- Sanitized SCIM event snippet (timestamp, user created, attrs)
- One-page control-mapping to SIG/CAIQ items (we can do a checklist)
- Security attestation note (signed by @noah_sece)
This should satisfy review teams and is faster than full log exports. :white_check_mark:
priya_cs: I can coordinate with the AE to get the org_id and sign-off for the support ticket. I'll ask legal if they need the attestation on letterhead or a standard form.
noah_sece: For MFA enforcement proof: we can supply Admin role policy screenshot + authn policy text. If they ask for service-account behaviour, note that our service accounts are token-based and MFA doesn't apply; we show conditional access rules and recommended least-priv scopes.
noah_sece: For audit samples: we'll redact IPs and device IDs. Offer aggregated counts instead of raw logs if they push back.
maria_sales: Perfect. Can we target EOD Mon for a draft bundle? We need it before Tue demo.
jin_eng: If CS creates the ticket now I can pull staging artifacts today and package examples.
priya_cs: Ticket created: SUP-4821 (org: northbridge-demo). Added legal contact and requested redaction guidance.
noah_sece: I'll draft the one-page SIG mapping and the attestation. Will include statements for SAML, MFA, RBAC, SCIM, and log redaction policy.
alex_solutions: If you want, I can turn the checklist into a PDF with screenshots and inline notes for the AE to send to the reviewer.
maria_sales: Thanks team — please ping here when components are uploaded. I'll confirm with NorthBridge that redacted samples are OK. :eyes:
